headline: The UI/UX area covers the app's look and feel and its main interactive surfaces — theming, navigation, settings, notifications, charts and dialogs — and the code backs up 8 of 12 tickets, with one already-built dialog still sitting in a To Do status.
what_is_there: The code shows a working dark/light theme system with accent colours, a collapsible navigation sidebar with sub-tabs, a settings entry point for provider/language/theme, in-app toast notifications, an on/off/auto model routing toggle, a smooth line chart used on the metrics dashboard, a permission request-and-confirm flow, and a general-purpose file editing dialog. The file editing dialog appears fully built despite being tracked as not started.
what_is_unclear: Four tickets could not be confirmed either way — the first-run welcome dialog, the workspace member management dialog, and two broad improvement items ('Update UI/UX' and the AI-flow experience directive). In each case the files the analysis looked at were unrelated to the ticket, or the ticket describes intent rather than a specific feature, so this says nothing about whether the work exists.
suggested_action: Confirm with the team whether the file editing dialog should be moved out of To Do, and ask whether the welcome dialog and workspace member management screens exist under names the analysis did not reach.
